{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders (status is 'completed')
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed['revenue'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue"}
